newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: GOLF-ELS TO REJOIN EUROPEAN PGA TOUR.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-ELS TO REJOIN EUROPEAN PGA TOUR.

text.p: World number four Ernie Els said on Friday he was rejoining the European Professional Golf Association (PGA) tour after a gap of two years.

"My international career began in Europe and I'll be playing more events there this year," said Els at the Glendower Golf Club where he is defending his South African Open crown in an event co-sanctioned by the South African PGA and the European PGA.

The South African remains a member of the United States PGA tour, where he is required to play at least 15 tournaments to retain his playing privileges, and the South African PGA which requires him to play only one event.
